app.tagline: Plan a year of the weather you want.
app.goal: Each month you pick one of three cities to live in. Then we play back the real weather those cities had. Get as many perfect days as you can.
home.streakEmpty: Play today's daily to start a streak.
onboarding.title: How it works
onboarding.perfect: Each month, pick 1 of 3 cities. That is where you spend the month.
onboarding.bad: Right after each pick, that month plays out with its real weather. Keep it, or spend a second chance to draw another year.
onboarding.pick: The days that match what you chase win. Opposite days lose.
about.title: About 365-0
about.attribution.title: Data
about.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), from ERA5 reanalysis by ECMWF and the Copernicus Climate Change Service. Processed by 365-0: daily values are grouped into six day types and are not the original data.
about.resolution: The weather comes from a grid about 25 km wide, so places in mountains or on small islands are regional approximations, not station readings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: 365-0 has no accounts and does not track you. Your progress stays on this device.
privacy.p2: The game stores your settings, your streak, your best endless record and your daily results in this browser, on this device only. Resetting progress in Settings deletes all of it.
privacy.p3: The weather data is a file that comes with the game. After the first load the game works offline.

stats.empty: Nothing here yet. Play a game and your results will show up.
stats.note: Kept on this device only. Resetting progress in Settings clears it.
settings.counts.hint: When a game starts or ends, the game tells the server which chase it was and the grade, nothing else: no name, no ID, no location. It helps tune the game. Off sends nothing.
privacy.p4: The one thing the game sends is an anonymous count: when a game starts or ends, which chase it was, daily or endless, and the grade. No name, no ID, no location is sent and the server stores totals only. You can switch it off in Settings, and nothing is sent while you are offline.

chase.sun.rules: Win: a perfect day. So-so days count as neither a win nor a loss. Loss: rain, storms, heat, or snow and frost.
chase.snow.rules: Win: a day with snow or frost. So-so days count as neither a win nor a loss. Loss: a hot or perfect day.
chase.rain.rules: Win: a rainy day. So-so days count as neither a win nor a loss. Loss: a dry perfect or hot day.
chase.storm.rules: Win: a stormy day. So-so days count as neither a win nor a loss. Loss: a perfect day.
chase.heat.rules: Win: a hot day. So-so days count as neither a win nor a loss. Loss: snow and frost or rain.
draft.scoutHelp: Each Scout uses one of your three per run. It compares this city's winning and losing days with other cities (1–5 of 5), not the exact number of days.
